title: 1996 Topps The X-Files #33 Our Town Episode Trading Card
descriptionText: The X-Files Topps trading card #33 features an original episode from the popular TV show "The X-Files" that aired on May 12, 1995. Manufactured by Topps in 1996, this card is part of the base set and is made of card stock. This vintage non-sport trading card measures standard size and is in English language. It is a must-have for fans of the franchise looking to collect unique and nostalgic pieces from "The X-Files" series.
